phase6.name: Testing & Optimization

migrationPath: 2. Build unified audio-worker service (download + processing + analysis)
3. Migrate frontend to Supabase Realtime and client-side Spotify API
5. Remove Redis (if using Supabase for queue) and PostgreSQL containers

improvements.scalability: Improved (Supabase scales automatically, workers scale horizontally)

architectureDiagram.current: Client → API Gateway → [Spotify, Download, Processing, Analysis, WebSocket] → Redis ← → All Services
architectureDiagram.proposed: Client → [Supabase Realtime, Spotify Web API, Audio Worker] → Supabase (PostgreSQL + Storage + Realtime)

proposed.infrastructure: Supabase (free tier: 500MB database, 1GB storage, generous realtime)

low: Replacing Redis cache with client-side cache
medium: Replacing WebSocket with Supabase Realtime (well-documented migration)
Consolidating services (requires refactoring but clear boundaries)
high: None - all replacements are proven technologies

recommendations: Start with Phase 1 & 2 in parallel - setup Supabase while building audio-worker
Keep Redis temporarily if using BullMQ for job queue (can migrate to Supabase Queue later)
Use Supabase Storage for all audio files (stems, downloads, analysis results)
Implement proper job state machine in PostgreSQL with triggers
Use Supabase Realtime for live progress updates instead of polling
Consider Supabase Edge Functions for rate limiting and validation
Setup proper monitoring from day 1 (Supabase has built-in monitoring)
Use feature flags to gradually migrate users to new architecture
Keep old services running during migration for rollback capability

eliminated: Docker volume management for audio files
Service discovery and health check overhead
introduced: Supabase vendor lock-in (mitigated: open-source, can self-host)

supabaseFeaturesToLeverage.storage: S3-compatible object storage with CDN, image transformations
supabaseFeaturesToLeverage.realtime: WebSocket subscriptions to database changes, custom channels, presence
supabaseFeaturesToLeverage.auth: User authentication if needed for multi-user features
supabaseFeaturesToLeverage.edgeFunctions: Deno-based serverless functions for custom logic
supabaseFeaturesToLeverage.queue: pg_cron or pg_net for job scheduling (or use external BullMQ)
supabaseFeaturesToLeverage.vector: pgvector extension for audio similarity search (future feature)

spotifyServerSide.otherwise: Client-side is simpler and reduces server load

successCriteria: Reduce Docker containers from 8 to 2 (audio-worker + Redis optional)
All realtime updates working via Supabase Realtime
Audio files stored in Supabase Storage
Job state tracked in Supabase PostgreSQL
No custom API Gateway or WebSocket code
